verdict.rationale: Brex Travel is documented as in-platform booking with 'global inventory and auto-enforced expense policies on one platform.' The API changelog adds a `policy` field to booking objects showing whether a booking was out of policy and which travel policy rules it broke, so policy is evaluated on the booking itself. A community user also reports using Brex Travel. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that flights and hotels specifically are bookable, clarity on whether out-of-policy bookings are blocked or only flagged at booking time, and in-depth first-party travel docs.
